summary: Explains ansible.netcommon.parse_cli (2.4+) for turning network CLI output into JSON using a YAML spec file, with an example spec that parses show vlan into a list of VLAN hashes via regex items.
questions: How do I convert network device CLI output into structured data?
How do I write a parse_cli spec file?
How do I parse show vlan output with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Parsing CLI output with parse_cli
answer_card.answer_md:
```jinja
{{ output | ansible.netcommon.parse_cli('path/to/spec') }}
```

The YAML spec defines `vars` (output shape) and `keys` with regex `items` using named groups:

```yaml
vars:
  vlan:
    vlan_id: "{{ item.vlan_id }}"
    name: "{{ item.name }}"
    state: "{{ item.state }}"
keys:
  vlans:
    value: "{{ vlan }}"
    items: "^(?P<vlan_id>\\d+)\\s+(?P<name>\\w+)\\s+(?P<state>active|act/lshut|suspended)"
```

This returns a list of VLAN hashes.
